description: This file defines the 'Framework' class which extends Symfony's HttpKernel. It sets up dependency injection, routing, logging, and request handling functionality for the OrangeHRM application, acting as the central entry point for HTTP requests within the system.

classes.name: Framework
classes.description: A central HTTP kernel extending Symfony's HttpKernel, responsible for application initialization including dependency injection, routing, logging, and request handling in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Framework class, configuring container and logger, and setting up essential services for request processing.

methods.name: configureContainer
methods.description: Registers core services such as request stack, route context, dispatcher, controller resolver, argument resolver, doctrine, and authentication chain into the service container.

methods.name: configureLogger
methods.description: Sets up the logging service with a logger factory and attaches a logger subscriber to the event dispatcher.

methods.name: configureRouter
methods.description: Configures routing by setting up route context, URL matcher, URL generator, URL helper, and event listeners for request, finish, and exception events.

methods.name: configurePlugins
methods.description: Loads and initializes plugins based on configuration files.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests by configuring routing and plugins, then delegating to the parent HttpKernel's handle method.

methods.name: isDebug
methods.description: Indicates whether the application is running in debug mode.
